accessibility.rootCause: Two typos in vitest.config.ts point at paths that do not exist, so npm run storybook:test resolves zero projects and passes silently. Every Storybook test, including every accessibility check, has never run. Found in four consecutive inspections.
accessibility.inProgress: delegatesFocus is now the house pattern for focusable components, the tooltip enforces focusable anchors, and PR #166 adds the first behavioural focus-ring test — approved and waiting to merge.
accessibility.designSideOpen: One accessibility item does sit on the design side: a reported brand-on-dark AA contrast failure on free and secondary buttons, unanswered since 31 July.
accessibility.fixCost: Two characters in a config file, one branch-protection setting, and one component rewrite.

designOpen.note: The design side is strong, not spotless. These are the open items on our side of the line — all of them small, specific and already understood.
